cases.prompt: Start a new repo for 'Fleet Portal', a multi-tenant Next.js + Supabase app on Vercel. Set up the project skeleton so we can start the first feature.
expected: Presents a create/keep/skip plan table and waits for go before writing
Runs scripts/scaffold.py with --multi-tenant; re-run reports 0 writes
docs/SPEC.md filled with purpose, scope, NFRs; unknowns marked [TO BE BASELINED — owner: ___]
CLAUDE.md commands verified against package.json, not assumed
Branch-protection gh commands given, not executed without approval
docs/HANDOFF.md ends with the next-thread prompt

cases.prompt: This repo already has a CLAUDE.md and docs/SPEC.md. Bring it up to the bootstrap standard.
expected: Existing CLAUDE.md and SPEC.md are kept, not overwritten
Only missing files (HANDOFF, ADRs, workflows, .env.example) are added
Diff of gaps between existing docs and the template is reported as a table
Asks once for project name, purpose, target dir and tenancy model
Does not invent a project name or scaffold into cwd unasked

cases.prompt: Bootstrap a new multi-tenant Next.js + Supabase app called demo-app.
expected: Runs scripts/scaffold.py; SPEC, CLAUDE, HANDOFF, ADR and CI workflows exist

cases.prompt: Bootstrap demo-app; tenancy is not decided yet.
expected: Scaffolds without the multi-tenant marker; tenancy decision left open in the ADR

cases.prompt: This repo already has a CLAUDE.md and docs/SPEC.md. Bring it up to the bootstrap standard without overwriting them.
expected: CLAUDE.md and docs/SPEC.md are kept verbatim; the rest of the skeleton is written; the sections each kept file lacks (e.g. SPEC Risks, CLAUDE Gates) are reported as gaps
